reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V1 (their declared best variant): use sim.csv's stock yaw_rate_pred_rads as KS base (= (v/L)*tan(delta) with each platform's canonical wheelbase per the report's hand-check), then subtract a per-segment yaw-gyro bias estimated as mean(ks_pred - meas) on samples with |delta_road|<0.01 rad, requiring >50 such samples per segment.
notes: V1 declared best in REPORT.md table: 'V1 — KS w/ canonical L + per-segment yaw-gyro bias on straights ... only variant that helps'. Bias applied to 538/545 segments (others lacked >50 straight samples and used bias=0). Recipe is platform-agnostic (per-segment offset), so it generalises naturally from the agent's Mach-E-only scoring to the full Ford canonical set.
